description: This Java class defines a ViewModel named `BaseActivityViewModel` for an Android application. It manages LiveData objects for FAB actions and a refresh tree of tasks, and interacts with `BaseActivity` to add and remove tracker listeners. The class structure includes an enum, private LiveData fields, a constructor, various public methods, and an override for cleanup.

classes.name: BaseActivityViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that manages UI state for FAB actions and a task refresh tree, utilizing LiveData for lifecycle-aware data observation, and interacts with `BaseActivity` for tracking listeners.

methods.name: BaseActivityViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing LiveData fields, setting up a task listener, and registering it with `BaseActivity`.

methods.name: actOnFab
methods.description: Updates the LiveData for FAB actions, allowing the UI to react accordingly.

methods.name: getFabActions
methods.description: Returns LiveData representing current FAB actions for UI observation.

methods.name: getRefresh
methods.description: Returns LiveData representing the task refresh tree.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Cleans up by removing the tracker listener from `BaseActivity` when the ViewModel is destroyed.
